name: Pandemic
description: Pandemic, 2nd edition (2013). Cooperative: cure four diseases before outbreaks overrun the world. On the Brink (2013 edition) is built in as options: its roles, events, Virulent Strain, Mutation and the Bio-Terrorist. Private local build: not for distribution.

epidemics.title: Epidemic cards
epidemics.description: 4 introductory, 5 standard, 6 heroic, 7 legendary (needs the On the Brink roles).

openHands.title: Open hands
openHands.description: Everyone sees every hand. Always on in the introductory game (4 epidemics); optional otherwise.

roles.title: On the Brink: roles
roles.description: Six more roles (Archivist, Containment Specialist, Epidemiologist, Field Operative, Generalist, Troubleshooter), a 5th player and the legendary game (7 epidemics).

events.title: On the Brink: events
events.description: Eight more events; the game uses 2 events per seat.

virulentStrain.title: Virulent Strain challenge
virulentStrain.description: Its 8 epidemic cards replace the normal ones; the first names the strain. Set Epidemic cards to 5 for the standard game.

mutation.title: Mutation challenge
mutation.description: A fifth, purple disease. Not with the Bio-Terrorist. Set Epidemic cards to 5 for the standard game.

bioterrorist.title: Bio-Terrorist challenge
bioterrorist.description: One seat, without a pawn, plays against the others with a secret location and the purple disease. Needs 3 to 5 seats. Not with Mutation. Set Epidemic cards to 5 for the standard game.
